name: Nimble Holdings Company Limited
summary: Nimble Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in property development and operation in the People's Republic of China and the United States. The company operates through PRC Property Development, Emerson, and PRC Household Appliances segments. It is also involved in the distribution of houseware and audio products; trading of household appliances, wires, and cables; and licensing businesses. The company was formerly known as The Grande Holdings Limited and changed its name to Nimble Holdings Company Limited in February 2018.
